headline: Frequent Rework of App.tsx Due to Overlapping Features
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a continuous effort to refactor and enhance the selection and editing features within App.tsx. This suggests that the current implementation may be overly complex or tightly coupled, leading to frequent fixes and modifications as new features are added or existing ones are adjusted.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the selection and editing logic within App.tsx to identify areas of complexity and potential coupling with other components.
Create a modular architecture for the selection and editing features, separating them into distinct components or hooks to reduce dependencies on App.tsx.
Implement comprehensive unit tests for the newly modularized components to ensure stability and prevent regressions during future changes.
Establish a clear ownership model for the components involved, assigning specific team members to maintain and evolve the selection and editing functionalities.
owner_hint: Assign a dedicated team member to oversee the refactoring and ongoing maintenance of the App.tsx features.
